faq.question: Is passport allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Passport is allowed in carry-on luggage. Passports are allowed in checked baggage, but you should NEVER check your passport as you will need it for boarding, customs, and identification.

faq.question: Can you pack passport in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Passport is allowed in checked bags.
